_comment: Frozen benchmark scores that the CI regression check gates against.
Update ONLY in an explicit PR with reviewer sign-off; bumping these
without rerunning the benchmark is a process violation.
target_recovered:    int   -- target-protein recovery from blinded_*.json
hard_recovered:      int   -- hard-case recovery (target != disease gene)
total_seconds_max:   int   -- 25% over this trips a COST regression
model + pipeline:    str   -- the config that produced these numbers
date:                str   -- ISO date of the run
notes:               str   -- anything reviewers should know

dev.pipeline: v0.5 (2-stage decomposition + self-consistency vote + always-fire critique)
dev.notes: v0.7 + Tier 1 + alias-bag fix for migraine_cgrp. 13/16 = 81% target, 6/8 hard. Note: every model with a training cutoff <= 2024 has likely seen these mappings; this is fitting, not generalization.

val.notes: Tool-use loop (agentic_target_research node) was added 2026-05-29. With it: 4/6 val (1/3 hard). Specifically recovered Garadacimab F12 (cascade disambiguation) and Resmetirom THRB (adjacency-correction). R1-Distill 8B without tools: 3/6 val (0/3 hard). GPT-4o without tools: 2/6 val (0/3 hard). The tool-use loop is the unlock; the frontier model alone was not.
